stories.headline: Microsoft Diversifies AI Stack with $2B Anthropic Deal
stories.blurb: Microsoft plans to pay Anthropic over $2 billion annually to integrate its models into Copilot and reduce reliance on OpenAI.

stories.headline: Google's Gemini 4 Argon Refactor Unblocks 6 Million Lines of Chromium
stories.blurb: Google leveraged its Gemini 4 Argon model to refactor millions of lines of legacy Chromium code, demonstrating AI's growing role in large-scale software maintenance.

stories.headline: Reflection AI Launches Top-Performing Open Model Beam
stories.blurb: Reflection AI released Beam, securing the second-highest spot among US open-weights models on the Artificial Analysis benchmark.

stories.headline: Nvidia Optimizes Kimi K3 Model to Achieve High Token Throughput
stories.blurb: Nvidia reached 423 tokens per second per user on the Kimi K3 model by applying custom vLLM optimizations.

stories.headline: StepFun Unveils Smartphone OS Centered on AI Agents
stories.blurb: Chinese startup StepFun launched a phone operating system built directly around an autonomous AI agent rather than traditional applications.

stories.headline: OpenAI Explores Acquisition of Trail of Bits
stories.blurb: OpenAI is in early discussions to acquire cybersecurity firm Trail of Bits to enhance its automated code safety and infrastructure defenses.

stories.headline: Banks Block Unauthorized AI Agents from Financial Operations
stories.blurb: Financial institutions including Schwab and JPMorgan are actively blocking AI agents from conducting financial transactions to prevent fraud.

stories.headline: JavaScript Parser Divergence Exposes Engine Inconsistencies
stories.blurb: Research across 37 JavaScript engines revealed that minor code formatting changes can alter program execution logic, creating severe security risks.

stories.headline: Anthropic AI Safety Legislation Sparks Industry Debate
stories.blurb: A proposed draft AI safety bill authored by Anthropic faces criticism over setting regulatory compliance thresholds based on raw training compute power.

stories.headline: Antithesis Secures $105M to Debug AI-Generated Code
stories.blurb: Automated testing startup Antithesis raised $105 million at a $525 million valuation to help developers catch bugs in AI-written code bases.

stories.headline: GitHub Actions Lockfiles Pin Commits for Secure Workflows
stories.blurb: GitHub Actions introduced workflow lockfiles that explicitly pin action commit SHAs while preserving semantic versioning, protecting CI/CD pipelines from supply chain attacks.

stories.headline: Xolotl Brings DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash to Single Consumer GPUs
stories.blurb: An open-source project called Xolotl enables developers to run the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model locally on a single consumer RTX 4090 card.

stories.headline: Behavioral Evaluation Uncovers Flaws in Open-Source AI Agents
stories.blurb: Testing across 53 open-source AI agent projects revealed widespread execution bugs, resulting in 37 filed bug reports.

stories.headline: SpaceX Expands Direct-to-Cell Satellite Infrastructure
stories.blurb: SpaceX is making heavy investments in Starlink's direct-to-cell service to deliver global mobile coverage and compete directly with legacy carriers.
